title: Vibrant Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A peppery and crumbly Whole30-friendly Tunisian dish featuring peach juice, made with lamb and served on a hot stone plate, perfect for meal prep.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, peach juice, cumin, coriander, black pepper, and salt.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the lamb marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Remove the lamb from the marinade and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Cook for 2 hours or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the lamb on a hot stone plate, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
